NON-STATE, ADDITIVE-ONLY: each line is APPENDED after the canonical battle-log line for a terminal/emotional, non-load-bearing moment; it NEVER replaces a state-information line (effectiveness, status, faint-as-state, 'But it failed!'). The pick must use the seeded storyRngNext (never Math.random). Wiring (append + seeded pick) is owned by Stream 4 — this file is the copy + the contract. See docs/story-design/story-immersion/dialogue-and-writing.md §8. The single loop-flavored 'familiar-made-wrong' line per pool (the last entry in playerLastFaint/foeLastFaint/fledRoad) is intentional and rationed — it should read as a passing thought, not a system message.
playerLastFaint: You keep your hand on the last Ball a moment.
The calls from your corner stop.
You lower the hand that was waiting to give an order.
Someone on the other side gives you a minute.
It's quiet enough to hear your boots on the ground.
You count the Balls on your belt by touch.
For a moment, all you want is a place to sit.
You know this particular quiet. You don't know how.
foeLastFaint: You can breathe all the way out now.
Across the field, a hand goes to the last Ball.
Whatever the next stretch holds, it can wait a second.
You let your hand fall to your side.
The other end of the field goes quiet.
You hadn't noticed how hard you were gripping the Ball.
You could swear you've stood through the quiet after this win before.
fledRoad: The open road is suddenly a welcome sight.
You leave the score right where it is.
The first step away is the hardest one to take.
A battle can wait. You keep going.
You don't look back until you're well clear.
The walk back takes fewer steps than you remember.
critKO: The opening was there for a heartbeat.
For an instant, the field goes still.
